objective: Theory spec of the LO Drell-Yan cross section and the O(alpha_s) angular coefficients with the Lam-Tung relation in theory:drell-yan-lo

model.description: LO Drell-Yan d2sigma/dM dy = (8 pi alpha^2/(9 M s)) sum e_q^2 [q1 qbar2 + qbar1 q2] (photon exchange) from PDG Eqs. 51.3 and 51.40, and the lepton angular coefficients lambda, nu at O(alpha_s) from the quark-axis picture of Peng et al. (Eqs. 2-10), with the Lam-Tung relation 1 - lambda - 2 nu = 0 for a coplanar quark axis

assumptions: photon exchange only (a = 0); massless quarks and leptons; unpolarized hadrons; N_c = 3
LO parton-model factorization (PDG Eq. 51.40); time reversal relates q qbar -> l+ l- to Eq. 51.3
angular coefficients at O(alpha_s): one emitted parton, no intrinsic transverse momentum
phi1 = 0 at O(alpha_s) (quark axis in the hadron plane): cited from Peng et al., not derived here
<sin^2 theta1> = r^2/(1 + r^2) for q qbar (exact) and 5 r^2/(1 + 5 r^2) for q g (approximate, Peng et al.)
channel mixture: A_i averaged with the angle-integrated cross-section fractions f_c of the channels in the same (qT, Q) bin (exact; equal to event fractions only with full angular acceptance)

conventions.unit_system: natural-HEP: M, sqrt(s) in GeV; d2sigma/dM dy in GeV^-3, or in nb/GeV through 4 pi alpha^2/3 = 86.8 nb GeV^2 [dylo:C01]; lambda, mu, nu, A_n dimensionless
conventions.metric_signature: not-applicable (no amplitude is computed; the partonic cross section is taken from PDG Eq. 51.3)
conventions.coupling_normalization: alpha = e^2/(4 pi) (QED); alpha_s enters only as the order O(alpha_s) of the gamma* g and gamma* q channels: lambda and nu at that order do not depend on the value of alpha_s
conventions.renormalization_scheme: not-applicable (LO cross section; the O(alpha_s) angular coefficients are ratios with no scheme-dependent input at this order)
conventions.energy_variable: dilepton mass M (Q in Peng et al.), hadronic s, tau = M^2/s; qT/Q for the angular coefficients
conventions.frame: Collins-Soper frame: dilepton rest frame, z axis bisecting the two hadron momenta, x axis in the hadron plane (Peng et al. Fig. 1) [dylo:C03]
conventions.angle_definition: theta, phi: polar and azimuthal angles of the negative lepton in the Collins-Soper frame; theta1, phi1: those of the quark axis z'; theta0: angle between the negative lepton and z' [dylo:C03, C04]
conventions.spin_treatment: unpolarized hadrons; spin-averaged partons, summed lepton spins
conventions.exchanged_bosons: photon only: a = 0 in Peng et al. Eq. 2 for all numbers (Z exchange and gamma-Z interference excluded)
conventions.em_coupling: alpha of PDG Eq. 51.3; whether alpha(0) or a running alpha is meant is not stated in the passage read; no numerical alpha is used (results in units of 4 pi alpha^2/3)
conventions.factorization_scheme: not-applicable (LO parton model, PDG Eq. 51.40; no coefficient functions)
conventions.rapidity_frame: hadronic centre-of-mass frame, +z along hadron 1; y = (1/2) ln(x1/x2), x1 = (M/sqrt(s)) e^y from hadron 1
conventions.azimuth_convention: Collins-Soper phi of the negative lepton measured from the hadron plane (Peng et al. Fig. 1)
conventions.dylo:angular_distribution: d sigma/d Omega propto 1 + lambda cos^2 theta + mu sin 2theta cos phi + (nu/2) sin^2 theta cos 2phi (Peng et al. Eq. 1, note nu/2) [dylo:C03]
conventions.dylo:channel_mixture: q g fraction f = angle-integrated cross-section fraction of the q g channel in the same (qT, Q) bin (an event fraction only with full angular acceptance); A_i^mix = sum_c f_c A_i^c exactly, equivalently lambda_mix = sum f_c lambda_c/(3 + lambda_c) / sum f_c/(3 + lambda_c) (derived in derive.py); a linear average of lambda or nu is wrong

extension.order: d2sigma/dM dy at O(alpha^2 alpha_s^0) (LO); lambda, nu and the Lam-Tung relation at O(alpha_s^1)

validity_domain.cross_section: photon exchange, M well below the Z mass and above resonance regions; LO only
validity_domain.angular_coefficients: O(alpha_s), qT > 0 generated by one hard emission; at small qT intrinsic transverse momentum and resummation (not included) matter; beyond O(alpha_s) non-coplanar emissions violate Lam-Tung (1 - lambda - 2 nu >= 0)
validity_domain.qg_channel: Eq. 9 is an approximation whose accuracy depends on the parton distributions (Peng et al.)

checks_run.name: colour average: sigma(q qbar -> l+ l-) = e_q^2 4 pi alpha^2/(9 s_hat) from PDG Eq. 51.3 (SymPy)
Jacobian |d(x1, x2)/d(tau, y)| = 1 and the map inverts (SymPy)
delta-function integration gives d2sigma/dM dy = (8 pi alpha^2/(9 M s)) e_q^2 L(M^2/s, y) (SymPy)
numerical: the formula integrated over an (M, y) box equals the parton integral over the matching (x1, x2) region, SYNTHETIC toy densities
Peng Eq. 4 substituted into Eq. 2 reproduces Eq. 5 identically (SymPy normal form modulo sin^2 + cos^2 = 1)
matching Eq. 3 to Eq. 5 gives A_0..A_7 of Eq. 6; Eq. 3 against Eq. 1 gives Eq. 7 (SymPy)
1 - lambda - 2 nu = 4 (A0 - A2)/(2 + A0); phi1 = 0 gives A0 = A2 and Lam-Tung; A0 - A2 = 2 sin^2 theta1 sin^2 phi1 >= 0 (SymPy)
Eqs. 8 and 9 in Eq. 7 reproduce Peng Eq. 10 for both channels (SymPy)

channel mixture: A_i terms of Eq. 3 integrate to zero over the sphere, 1 + cos^2 to 16 pi/3; the cross-section-weighted sum of channel distributions is Eq. 3 with the weighted A_i, i.e. lambda_mix = sum f lambda/(3 + lambda) / sum f/(3 + lambda) (SymPy)
limits: qT -> 0 gives lambda = 1, nu = 0; qT -> infinity gives lambda = -1/3 (SymPy)
published closed form (Peng Eq. 10) against the profile's numbers, 2 channels x 7 qT/Q values
units: lambda, mu, nu dimensionless; cross section in (4 pi alpha^2/3) GeV^-3

checks_not_run: independent check of Peng Eq. 9 (q g channel): cited approximation, not recomputed from the matrix element
derivation of phi1 = 0 at O(alpha_s): cited, not derived
comparison with measured lambda, nu or cross sections (no data in this profile)
Z exchange, NLO cross section, qT resummation, intrinsic transverse momentum

references_read.citation: H. Baer and R.N. Cahn, 'Cross-Section Formulae for Specific Processes', in F. Takahashi et al. (Particle Data Group), Int. J. Mod. Phys. A 41, 2630011 (2026)
J.-C. Peng, W.-C. Chang, R.E. McClellan and O. Teryaev, 'Interpretation of Angular Distributions of Z-boson Production at Colliders', arXiv:1511.08932v3 (2016)
references_read.location: Eq. (1) p. 1; Eqs. (2)-(7) p. 2; remarks after Eq. (7) and Eqs. (8)-(10) p. 3; coplanarity at leading order alpha_s, p. 4

neglected: O(alpha_s) corrections to the cross section
